class.name: AnimationLODController
class.brief_description: Reduces animation update rate for distant or off-screen characters.
class.description: Equivalent of Unreal's Animation Update Rate Optimization and Unity's Animator Culling Mode. Registered [AnimationMixer] nodes are switched to [constant AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_MANUAL] and advanced every frame within [member near_distance] of the active [Camera3D], every 2nd frame within [member mid_distance], every 4th within [member far_distance] and not at all beyond that or when off-screen. Skipped delta is accumulated (capped by [member max_accumulated_delta]) so animation time stays correct. Distance is measured to the nearest [Node3D] ancestor of the mixer. Mixers that are not [member AnimationMixer.active] are not advanced. Original callback modes are restored on unregistering, disabling or leaving the tree. Optionally disables [SkeletonModifier3D] nodes (IK) below the mixer's root node beyond [member modifier_cull_distance] or when culled.

method.name: clear_mixers
method.description: Unregisters all mixers and restores their callback modes.

method.name: get_mixer_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered mixers.

method.name: unregister_mixer
method.description: Stops managing [param mixer] and restores its callback mode and any disabled modifiers.

method.name: update_interval
method.description: Returns the frame interval: 1 below [param near], 2 below [param mid], 4 below [param far], and 0 (paused) otherwise or when [param visible] is [code]false[/code].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], characters outside the camera frustum are paused.
Enables the controller. Disabling restores all mixers' original callback modes.
Below this distance mixers update every 4th frame; beyond it they are paused.
Maximum accumulated delta in seconds passed to a single advance.
Below this distance mixers update every 2nd frame.
Beyond this distance (or when culled) [SkeletonModifier3D] nodes are disabled. Set to 0 to disable this feature.
Below this distance mixers update every frame.
